quotes: People are disturbed not by things, but by the views they take of them.||Epictetus
The story you tell about what happened shapes how it feels.
A new story isn't denial. It's a more complete one.
You can't control the first thought. You can choose the second.
posts.caption:
Same event, different story, different feeling. 🪞

Epictetus, Enchiridion 5 (modernized from the Carter translation). Psychologists call the skill cognitive reframing. General psychology ideas, not medical advice.

quotes: If it is not right, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it.||Marcus Aurelius
posts.caption:
A simple rule for a clean conscience. 🤍

Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 12.17 (Long translation).

quotes: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.||Seneca
Small, repeated steps change your brain faster than one big leap.
Rest isn't laziness. Recovery is when growth settles in.
Compare today with yesterday's you, not someone else's highlights.
posts.caption:
Your time is your life. Spend it like it. ⏳

Seneca, On the Shortness of Life 1.3 (Basore translation). General psychology ideas, not medical advice.

quotes: Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.||Seneca
posts.caption:
Today counts as a whole life. 🌅

Seneca, Letters to Lucilius 101 (Gummere translation).
